<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Pui Pui''' is the first of [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]]'s guards in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]], fought at [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Babidi's Spaceship]]. He can also be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. He flies, hops back from your hits and pelts you with purple ki.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Pui Pui is one of the Buu Saga fighters that can be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. Like every contender, he is drawn at random and revealed once everybody accepts the rules.

<!--T:8-->
His stats come from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments#Configuration|contender entry]] that drew him: by default between 238,000 and 612,500 health, 9,900 to 25,800 melee damage and 8,840 to 23,460 ki damage, on the Smart AI tier for the four weakest entries and Elite for the other five. He gets 8% stronger for every round already played.

<!--T:9-->
Hover him on the tournament screen to see his stats; with Bulma's '''Threat Database''' scan data you also see his ki attacks.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Pui Pui flies and has no combos, no [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Zanzoken]] and no teleport. When you land a hit on him, he can hop back out of reach.

<!--T:12-->
* '''Ki Volley:''' a barrage of purple ki blasts.
* '''Ki Blast:''' a single purple ki blast.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 11, '''Babidi's Guard: Pui Pui''': defeat him at [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Babidi's Spaceship]].
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Sidequests#Combat|side quest]] '''Babidi's Ship''', available after Buu Saga quest 17, sends you back to the ship to defeat him again.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest 25, '''Hell's Escapees''': he is one of the five villains you defeat in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Yakon|Yakon]].
</translate>
